ai_off: AI chat is not connected yet
without_ai: You can read and organise documents, view connected school deadlines, and make a study plan without AI. Answers about your reading need a connected AI service.
step_access: Choose an AI service approved by your school. Ask your teacher or IT team if you are unsure. A ChatGPT or Claude chat subscription does not include API credit. The service may charge separately.
step_key: Use Get a key below for that service. Paste its secret code into the matching field. Choose Use without saving keys for this session, or Save key. If secure storage permission is denied, you can retry or use the session option.
step_answer: Select Test connection and wait for confirmation. Close Settings, choose a model in Chat, select a passage, and ask a question. If the check fails, follow its message or ask your school for help.
no_account: No AI account or secret code?
ask_school: You do not need Terminal or a paid account to keep reading. Ask your teacher or IT team which AI access your school permits. You can copy this request:
school_request: I use VStudy Pro to read course materials. Does our school provide an approved AI service and an API key? How do I connect it, and are there any costs or restrictions? If AI access is unavailable, who can help me with questions about my reading?
privacy: Never paste your school password into AI settings or a chat. A connected AI service receives your question, chat history, and document context, including selected text. Check your school rules before sharing coursework.
advanced: Advanced · local services and Terminal tools
advanced_help: These options are for students who already use a local AI service or a command-line tool. You can skip them.
usage_help: AI services measure text in tokens, which are small pieces of words. Input includes your question and shared document context. Output is the answer. More text can cost more. The money shown is an estimate, not your account balance.
